beats.headline: The airfield is yours!
beats.body: 150 million for a strip of tarmac, a windsock and one check-in desk. The first plane is already on its way in.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Thirty years I flew out of here. Check your passengers in, open the gate, and get that plane away on time.

beats.headline: Your first flight left on time!
beats.body: Every flight that beats its clock pays a bonus, and each one in a row pays a little more than the last.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: A full plane, away on the dot. Step onto the ramp pad just as the ring closes and the pilots will tip you, too.

beats.headline: The fuel truck has arrived!
beats.body: Planes that leave with full tanks fly further, and every flight is worth more. Stand by the hose to fill one up.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Fuel first, then passengers. A plane that waits for fuel misses its clock.

beats.headline: Gate 2 is open!
beats.body: Two planes on the ground at once, and twice the passengers. Keep both clocks in the green.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Two gates and one of you. You'll want some crew before long.

beats.headline: You’ve hired a check-in agent!
beats.body: The desk runs itself now, so you can stay out on the apron with the planes.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: That's an airline finding its feet. Now you can keep your eyes on the sky.

beats.headline: You’ve hired a ground handler!
beats.body: The cases and the fuel are taken care of. All you do is open the gates and wave the planes off.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Loading and fuelling sorted. Now find someone to wave them off.

beats.headline: Skyport runs itself!
beats.body: The ramp dispatcher opens the gates and sends every flight off on time, even while you're away.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: A proper little airport. Bay City wants jets next, and a terminal to match. Start with a café: passengers love a coffee.

beats.headline: The Sky Café opens!
beats.body: Passengers stop for a coffee on their way to the gate. Stand behind the counter to serve them, and keep an eye on your flights.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Nobody flies well on an empty stomach. A café pays its way, and the passengers wait happier.

beats.headline: The new wing opens, and the first jet lands!
beats.body: Gate 3 has a jet bridge, and its jets carry twice the passengers. Everyone flying from it goes through security first. Cases now come in each gate's colour: take them to the hold of the same colour.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: A jet bridge! In my day we walked across the tarmac in the rain. Mind the colours on the cases.

beats.headline: The catering kitchen is cooking!
beats.body: Jets pay more with their meals aboard: carry trays from the kitchen's hatch to the jet's back door. Spare trays make sandwiches for the café.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Four trays for a jet, and its passengers tip the pilots for a hot meal.

beats.headline: Skyport flies through the night!
beats.body: Now and then night falls: the runway lights glow, the terminal shines, and every flight that leaves in the dark pays more.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: There's nothing like a night take-off. Watch those lights stream past.

beats.headline: Skyport has a real terminal!
beats.body: A barista at the café and a clerk at duty-free: the shops take money while you're out on the apron.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Jets, shops, a kitchen and night flights. Next, the city wants a control tower.

beats.headline: Gate 4 takes the big ones
beats.body: Thirty-six seats a time. Fuel, cases and meals as for a jet, just more of everything.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Those engines! Keep the trays and the cases coming, and the wide-bodies pay like nothing else.

beats.headline: You choose what lands next
beats.body: Tap the tower button to pick the next flight: a holiday charter, an ordinary flight, or one of Goldsby Air's cut-price hops.
beats.speaker: rival
beats.words: Goldsby Air flies cheaper than anyone. Quick hops, no bags, no fuss. You'll see.

beats.headline: A foggy morning
beats.body: Nothing can land until it lifts. The planes are circling; when it clears they'll come in one after another.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Good time to get every plane on the ground turned round. The rush is coming.

beats.headline: Passengers by the busload
beats.body: The airport shuttle brings a busload at a time, enough to fill the wide-bodies.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: More passengers than ever. Keep that check-in desk quick.

beats.headline: Your own airline
beats.body: A plane in your colours. Pick its routes at the office: further cities pay more, and it brings home souvenirs.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Your name on the tail. I flew for thirty years and never had that.

beats.headline: Private jets welcome
beats.body: Now and then a celebrity flies in. Roll out the carpet, bring a fresh juice, call the limousine: every wish is a tip.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Celebrities don't wait. Be quick and they tip like royalty.

beats.headline: A celebrity at Skyport
beats.body: The photographers are already at the door. Grant all three wishes for the full tip.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Smile for the cameras!

beats.headline: The bag sorter is running
beats.body: Cases go straight from the belt into every hold on belt loaders, each in its gate's colour.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: No more carrying cases. Your hands are free for the important things.

beats.headline: You've hired a tower controller
beats.body: Whenever you haven't chosen, the controller brings in the best-paying flight.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: A steady voice in the tower. That's half of flying.

beats.headline: You've hired a marshal
beats.body: The marshal guides every plane onto its stand, for the parking bonus on every flight.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Next the city wants cargo, a hangar, and a second runway. Goldsby Air won't like that.

beats.headline: Freighters at Skyport
beats.body: Freighters land at the cargo stand. Carry crates from the shed's dock to the loader at the freighter's door: a full freighter pays for every crate.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: No passengers, no clock. Just crates, and plenty of them.

beats.headline: You've hired a cargo crew
beats.body: The crew loads every freighter from the dock.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Strong arms. Mind your toes.

beats.headline: The maintenance hangar
beats.body: Mogul Air's planes wear with every trip, and a worn plane brings home less. Worn ones now come home to the hangar: stand by the plane to service it, and its next trips pay more.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: A plane looked after is a plane that looks after you.

beats.headline: You've hired a mechanic
beats.body: The mechanic services worn planes in the hangar.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Oil on the hands, a song on the radio. Every hangar needs one.

beats.headline: Mogul Air doubles its fleet
beats.body: A second plane in your colours flies routes of its own. Choose for both on the routes board.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Two planes, two cities at once. Now you're an airline.

beats.headline: The airlines are back
beats.body: Planes take off from the new runway while the first takes the landings. The big airlines are back, and Goldsby Air has closed its cut-price hops for good.
beats.speaker: rival
beats.words: Two runways? Fine. Keep your airport, Mogul. Goldsby Air's flying off somewhere quieter.

beats.headline: The car wash, come full circle
beats.body: Airlines book their jets in for a wash: a gantry of brushes rolls over each one. Stand at the controls and it washes twice as fast.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: From a bucket and a sponge to this. Who'd have thought it?

beats.headline: Skyport goes global
beats.body: Freighters, a hangar, two runways and the cleanest jets in the world. And the manager keeps it all earning while you're away.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Only one thing left: the Sky Queen. The biggest plane there is.

beats.headline: The biggest plane there is
beats.body: Two decks, four engines and Mogul Air's colours from nose to tail. Everything at Skyport earns more for her, and now and then she's off on a world tour. Wave her off from her stand for a perfect send-off.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: A car wash, a farm, a fun park and now an international airport. Look at you, mogul. I couldn't be prouder.
